Support establishment, documentation and continuous improvement of Standard Work for operational and transactional processes impacting the financial statements, including closing, reporting and analysis. Support key non-commercial processes such as Logistics, Restructuring, Grants, Sales Incentive Compensation, Fleet, Dilapidation and other operational balance sheet areas.
